تعتطفن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَطِفْنَ (taʕtaṭifna) /taʕ.ta.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# تُعْتَطَفْنَ (tuʕtaṭafna) /tuʕ.ta.tˤaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
